responsibility: Defines the Arm backend’s UNSPEC and related internal opcode enumerations used in RTL to represent target-specific operations that do not map directly to generic RTL codes. It assigns the symbolic numbers for PIC/TLS forms, barriers, unaligned accesses, stack protector sequences, iWMMXt, Neon, MVE, crypto, CDE, and many other backend-specific operations so machine-description patterns and C++ backend code share a consistent internal operation namespace.
